cues.text: Fountain Square, decorated for Christmas and busy with people. You and Fuuka walk in side by side and stop to take in the decorations.
The two of you walk on to a quieter spot by the doors of a café, people passing now and then. Fuuka stops and turns to you, smiling.
Fuuka holds out the cookies she baked herself, and you take them.
Fuuka steps a little closer to you.
